fields.statement: At 1bf699e7: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/^health$' passes; health.txtar asserts the built-in plan-milestone line alone, then with .rhiza/workflows/bugfix.toml (autonomous = true) the line 'workflow bugfix (.rhiza/workflows/bugfix.toml): plan auto, accept auto, ship auto, signoff auto' plus plan-milestone with plan, accept, ship and signoff owner, and cmp of health --json against api call health. By hand with a scratch build in a fresh repo: without a repo workflow the autonomy detail lists only 'workflow plan-milestone (builtin:plan-milestone): plan owner, accept owner, ship owner, signoff owner' after the four rhiza.autonomy.* settings; with bugfix.toml added it also lists bugfix with its file and all four stages auto; health --json and api call health are byte-identical. Diff reviewed: healthWorkflowAutonomy unions personal, repo and built-in names, resolves each through resolveWorkflow (so precedence holds), and lists only workflows declaring a stage. go test -short -run Health ./internal/api passes; the other internal/api failures seen (TestReadBudget timeout at load 15, a usage.live.json leak into the enclosing root, TestRunStartAgentRefusalsBeforeWrite) are unrelated to health, and the last also fails at the parent 1e97bc3f.
